name: Otto Coilshell
acting: Eyes up and mouth pressed flat.
personality: Shares a shell with something that won't share a schedule.
note: The occupant answered the door from inside Otto's head. He asked me to leave it a note anyway.

name: Faye Siftspore
personality: Samples airborne trouble before anyone else can name it.
note: She filtered out three spores and a rumor. The rumor had passed through twice.
call: Hold still. I'm tasting the air.
voice: Dry, with a slight upward inflection.

name: Hugo Hatchclick
acting: Soft downward gaze and uneven smile.
personality: Knows when a quiet hatch needs one more minute.
note: The antennae emerged before the creature. He called that an early signal.

name: Nell Mosslift
acting: Eyes lifted toward the crest and narrow gape.
personality: Is the last to know what is growing over her head.
note: The fungus had reached its destination. Nell was still on the way to hers.

name: Bo Bubbleside
acting: Eyes forward and a concentrated squiggle mouth.
personality: Keeps his spare pressure in plain sight.
note: He held his breath until the air sac made the decision for him.

name: Cal Saltlick
acting: Downward eyes and a tongue caught mid-taste.
personality: Trusts his tongue with tasks his common sense declined.
note: Cal assured me it was only a sample. The sample was visibly smaller when he said it.
